text:
mika-sales: Heads up Customer: NovaTel POC. Requirements: EU-only processing, vendor control-plane must be inside EU, BYOK HSM, and a notarized snapshot of sub-processors. AE needs a 1-page presales brief with options and delta. Who can help?

olaf-ops: I can scope. Quick clarifier: do they require vendor-hosted EU control-plane or do they accept a customer-managed control plane in their VPC? That changes the path.

mika-sales: They said vendor control-plane in EU is OK but strict that no control-plane telemetry leaves EU.

claire-legal: Noted. If vendor control-plane must be EU, hosted standard plan won't comply unless we spin a Private control plane in EU. I'll pull the subproc list and SOC2 timestamps and prepare a notarized export. Also need to confirm which data fields they consider "control-plane telemetry".

dave-pricing: I can draft numbers. Tell me expected QPS, token mix, POC duration, and model.

paul-ml: Model: 7B quant recommended, lower memory and faster P95; but they asked about 13B too. For 7B expect lower infra footprint.

mika-sales: POC inputs: 10 qps baseline, 60 qps peak bursts, avg 130 tokens per request, prefer 7B quant for trial, 30 day POC.

infra-bot: Presales snippet:
```
route_policy: "tenant_affinity: eu-west-1"
control_plane_residency: "eu_only: true"
kms: "BYOK-HSM: external, mTLS, cert_exchange"
fallback: "fallback_model: 7B-quant-smaller"
network_reqs: "ip_allowlist, peering, nat, egress_paths"
```
Include note: hosted+BYOK requires outbound TLS to customer HSM endpoints; cert stamping + acceptance test required.

olaf-ops: Ops caveats: three variants:
1) Hosted+regional-data-plane: fastest (~2 business days) but control-plane may still be multi-region. Not acceptable if they insist EU control-plane residency.
2) Dedicated EU GPU pool (reserved): good mid-ground; we can combine with an EU-only control-plane in some cases; lead time ~2-3 weeks.
3) Private (full EU control-plane & data-plane in customer VPC or our EU-only control plane): highest compliance; lead time ~4-6 weeks, more integration work (networking, certs, HSM connector).

claire-legal: For BYOK-HSM we require proof-keeps: envelope encryption with customer KEK; we need to capture the keyflow diagram and sign a DPA addendum. Private makes attestation easier.

dave-pricing: Initial ballparks (EUR):
- HOSTED+REGIONAL (geo-affinity):  2,800/month + one-time networking & SLA setup  3,200
- DEDICATED EU RESERVED:  7,200/month + onboarding  2,000
- PRIVATE EU CONTROL PLANE:  19,500/month + integration SOW  8,000 (lead time 4-6 weeks)
BYOK-HSM integration SOW estimate:  4k- 9k depending on HSM vendor & cert work.

paul-ml: Performance note: 7B quant should keep median token latency ~120-220ms at these QPS with small batch sizes; 13B will increase infra need and cost. Include in one-pager.

nora-se: Security note: require mTLS to customer HSM, signed cert exchange, and a documented failover policy if HSM connectivity fails (e.g., agreed maintenance window or fail closed). Also request the customer provide IP ranges for allowlist and any corporate firewall rules.

mika-sales: Perfect. Can someone assemble a 1-page decision matrix with columns: Option, Security/Residency, Cost (monthly + one-time), Lead time, Ops complexity, Recommended for POC? Need by EOD so AE can send to customer.

olaf-ops: I'll draft ops checklist: network flow diagrams, certificate exchange steps, acceptance test for HSM connectivity, fallback runbook, and estimated setup time per option.

claire-legal: I'll produce notarized subproc snapshot + SOC2 certificate dates and a DPA addendum template. Need customer legal contact to confirm signature flow.

dave-pricing: I'll create the one-pager with the numbers above and footnote the BYOK SOW.

mika-sales: Action items recap: @dave-pricing one-pager, @olaf-ops ops checklist + timelines, @claire-legal subproc notarized export + DPA, @paul-ml perf appendix, @nora-se security checklist. I'll schedule a 20m handoff with AE tomorrow 11:30 CET. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
